name: Five-color sticky rice
summary: Thái feast rice in five colors. Báo Sơn La, on 11 February 2021, in bản Cọ Châu, phường Chiềng Cơi, dyes red with lá cơm nếp đỏ boiled about 30 minutes, purple with lá cơm nếp đen, yellow with old turmeric, and green with ginger leaf, lá cơm xôi xanh, or sticky-rice-straw ash pounded with black rice leaf. The rice soaks about 10 hours and steams over even charcoal. White is named in the color meanings, and that article prints no dye step for it. On 4 September 2020 the same paper soaks nếp tan in khảu cắm leaf water for white, purple, red, yellow, and green. Both dye accounts stay.
origin: Thái households. Báo Sơn La, 11 February 2021 and 4 September 2020.
culture: The 11 February 2021 account sets the tray on the ancestor altar at Tết Síp Xí, on the 14th of the seventh lunar month, at Tết, and for guests, often as a five-petal ban flower. Red is the will to live, purple is fertile land, yellow is plenty, green is the forest and the sky, and white is faithful love. The 4 September 2020 account ties the five colors to âm, dương, the five elements, and solidarity. Those meanings are not one list.
texture: Báo Sơn La, on 11 February 2021, says the rice is chewy and fragrant and does not stick to the hand when the fire stays even.
howToEat: With grilled meat cake, grilled fish, grilled chicken, ruốc, or toasted sesame salt, or on its own. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Cọ Châu, phường Chiềng Cơi, on the 11 February 2021 account, and the Thái feast table. A price is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Xoi ngu sac in Son La — two ways to dye the rice
seoDescription: Xôi ngũ sắc in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La dyes it with several leaves in 2021 and with khảu cắm leaf water in 2020. White has no dye step in the 2021 account. Check on arrival.
